name: twitter.select
description: Deterministically select posts from an X archive export by predicate and emit a compact twitter plan of delete acts, no agent judgment.

objective.description: One bounded objective for this bulk selection.

principal.description: The account being operated, for example account:@handle.

archive_file.description: Path to an X archive export file (tweets.js).

predicate.description: Typed selection predicate: rt_of, is_retweet, text_prefix, text_contains, max_likes, max_reposts, before_year, after_year. A post must satisfy every provided field.

max_acts.description: Cap on selected acts; a larger match set is flagged truncated.
